title: Recent changes
summary: The latest player-facing changes reflected in this guide.
body:
October 18 — ordinary loot tuning prepared

20% Polished, 5% Exalted and 1% Ascended per eligible ordinary equipment/bag drop are prepared, awaiting activation. Hunt, dungeon and quest rewards are unchanged.

October 17, 2026: progression, combat and crafting

  • The optional Recommended AA filter provides an early survival, sustain and damage shortlist across held classes.
  • Passive AA is now 10%, preserving full leveling EXP, earned points and 4,000 AA XP per point.
  • Six basic Monk attacks have separate reuse. Cooldown duration repairs address excessive and restarted timers; other shared identities remain under investigation.
  • Normal death costs no EXP or levels; prior losses are not refunded.
  • Stackable items support at least 100, retaining larger limits.
  • The Reforging Box accepts three identical eligible Normal/Base copies for Polished. Higher recipes still cost four.
  • Idle zones can unload without ending their workers and triggering a whole-game restart.
  • Update through launcher Play for the matched client. Gameplay and balance acceptance continue.

October 16, 2026

  • The dungeon guide now lists every required boss and explains boss-stage notices, full-clear credit and Keeper Status when task objectives are blank.
  • Raid and Grind dungeons are deployed for live testing with personal boss checklists, shared rewards and exclusive Raid drops. Gameplay and balance acceptance remain open.
  • Features now gathers the major departures from Classic.
  • Equipment eligibility recognizes held classes and permits playable races when the class matches; remaining restrictions still apply.
  • Temporary AA buffs retain their timers; ordinary blessings remain lasting.
  • Mira Coinwell provides tunnel banking. Haldra stocks Leather Padding.
  • The wiki’s guides, commands and generated reward pages have been reviewed together against current release evidence.

October 13, 2026

  • Passive AA changed from 40% to 20%, preserving full normal XP and 4,000 AA XP per point.
  • All allowed AA ranks open at level 1; points, eligibility and prerequisite ranks remain.
  • Stacked tradeskill ingredients and Craft All are deployed.
  • The tunnel workshop layout is more spacious; the Unrest waypoint moved beside its entrance Keeper.
  • Supported divine summoned-hammer families have zero resale value.
  • The reported multiclass training/offhand issue and merchant Sell All button issue were confirmed resolved.

October 11–12, 2026

  • Reusable four-copy upgrades are available from Artisan Veyra; higher #zoneforge steps now use four copies.
  • LORE restrictions are disabled. Food and drink requirements were removed.
  • Early scribing allows eligible scrolls into the spellbook before their casting level.
  • Sell All protects food, drink, reagents and casting focus items.
  • The launcher uses personal access codes and shows patch summaries.
  • Waypoint portals and floating-eye Instance Keepers received visual corrections. The reported pet-summon crash was confirmed resolved.

October 9, 2026

  • 48 Classic reward zones, 384 reward variants, type-22 augments and zone forging launched.
  • Passive AA increased to 40% at that time; the October 13 reduction above supersedes that rate.
  • Always Loot / Never Loot controls, effective Spell Damage on Throw Stone, and retained spell gems after normal death were added.

Release labels describe availability, not completed balance or gameplay acceptance. See In development for candidates.
